主要内容: BROOKFIELD ASSET MANAGEMENT INC. issued 4.250% Senior Unsecured Notes due June 2, 2026, with a size of US$500,000,000. The trade date was May 25, 2016, with an expected settlement date of June 2, 2016. The yield is 4.370%, and the notes have denominations starting at US$2,000. The notes include covenants such as change of control and negative pledge. Redemption provisions include a make-whole call prior to March 2, 2026, and a par call at 100% of the principal amount on or after March 2, 2026. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include BAMACN.
